mp: MP is a member of the military police who polices soldiers and guards prisoners.
MP can also mean a military corps that enforces discipline and guards prisoners.
MP means the same as military policeman or military police.
mpeg: MPEG is a set of standards adopted by the moving pictures experts group for the compression of digital video and audio data or a file of data compressed according to those standards.
mph: A mph is the ratio of the distance traveled to the time spent traveling.
Mph can also mean a speedometer reading for the momentary rate of travel.
Mph means the same as miles per hour.
mps: MPS is a widely distributed system of free and fixed macrophages derived from bone marrow.
MPS means the same as mononuclear phagocyte system or system of macrophages.
